europe_now.title: Suspected Terrorist Shooting Near Paris
europe_now.summary: French authorities and anti-terrorism police are investigating a fatal shooting in a town outside Paris that left one person dead and four others wounded. President Emmanuel Macron and other officials condemned the incident as a racist terrorist attack following the arrest of a suspect.

sources.headline: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says

europe_now.title: Large-Scale Prisoner Swap Between Ukraine and Russia
europe_now.summary: Ukraine and Russia have successfully completed a major prisoner exchange, with each side releasing 270 prisoners of war. The high-level swap comes amid ongoing regional conflicts and heightened tensions concerning security and detainees.

sources.headline: Ukraine and Russia each exchange 270 prisoners of war

top_stories.title: Domestic Unrest and Security Measures in France
top_stories.summary: President Emmanuel Macron held meetings with student union representatives as ongoing civil unrest and demonstrations continue across the country. French authorities have responded by tightening public restrictions and banning specific protests amidst growing socioeconomic and political pressures.

top_stories.title: Anti-Corruption Investigation and Detention in Hungary
top_stories.summary: Hungarian authorities have placed the former central bank chief into custody as part of a significant anti-corruption proceeding. The high-profile arrest highlights shifting legal developments within the country's institutional landscape.
